newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Atlanta, Ga..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Atlanta, Ga..

text.p: $8,000,000 Various Purpose General Obligation Bonds, Series
Sealed bids will be received by the Acting Chief Financial Officer of the City of Atlanta, Georgia (the City'') until 12:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Monday,

in the Chief Financial Officer's Conference Room, Suite 11100, 68 Mitchell Street, SW, Atlanta, Georgia 30335 for the purchase of all, but not part, of the City's $36,500,000 General Obligation Bonds, Series 1996, consisting of
$8,000,000 City of Atlanta Various Purpose General
Bonds'') and $28,500,000 City of Atlanta Public Improvement General Obligation Bonds, Series 1996B (the Public

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry only form and will fully registered in the name of the registered owner thereof as shown on the registration books of the City maintained by the Bond Registrar. The Bonds will be dated December 1, 1996 and will mature on December 1 in the years and amounts as follows:
Year Principal Amount Year Principal Amount
Series A Series B Series A Series B

The Bonds are general obligations of the City payable from the levy of a direct annual ad valorem tax, without limitation as to the rate or amount, upon all property subject to taxation within the City. The approving opinion of Powell, Goldstein, Frazer & Murphy and Sales, Goodloe & Golden with respect to the Various Purpose Bonds'' and the

Public Improvement Bonds'' will be furnished to successful bidder at the expense of the City. The Bonds will awarded to the responsible bidder who offers to purchase the Bonds at the lowest true interest cost, as provided in the more detailed Official Notice of Sale.

Additional information including the Official Notice of Sale, the Official Bid Form and the Preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained form the undersigned, John E. Tarver, DOBBS RAM & Company, 615 Peachtree Street, NE, Suite 1200, Atlanta, Georgia 30308; Telephone (404) 897-1033 or Marcy Edwards, Public Resources Advisory Group, 40 Rector Street, Suite 1600, New York, New York 10006, (212) 566- 7800.
The City reserves the right to reject any and all bids and waive informalities in any and all bids.
